intent: Hands out non-conflicting TCP ports from a fixed range to BedrockTester instances so parallel tests don't collide, recycling returned ports once confirmed free.

objects.name: PortMap
objects.role: allocates ports sequentially from a fixed range, recycles returned ones, and confirms a port is bindable before handing it out

naming_quality.note: Consistent with repo convention (_-prefixed private members); not S-prefixed, but it's test-only infrastructure rather than a libstuff shared utility type.
